name: Social Preview Banner
purpose: 1200x630 social preview banner and launch hero card.
visual: Wide panoramic crimson sunrise landscape with samurai and fortress silhouettes.
prompt: A minimalist 2D graphic illustration for a premium video game, inspired by bold cinematic silhouette poster art. Wide panoramic landscape showing a lone samurai silhouette standing before a massive dark shogun fortress on a mountain ridge under a colossal solid crimson-red sun disc. Pitch black foreground, razor sharp vector edges, cinematic negative space, no anime, no 3D, no text.
